title: Glass Painting Class
includes: We provide all the materials needed.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Comfy clothes, shoes, and a smile!
Aprons and all materials will be provided in the studio.
Glass Paintings are left in the studio for drying.
You will be contacted within 10 business days for pick-up.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Anyone 5 years old and up is capable of doing this fun and easy glass painting experience with parental supervision.
We provide all the materials needed.

The standard size for this experience is an 8”x11” picture frame, with the option to upgrade to larger sizes in the studio for an upcharge.
All of your experiences are instructor-led and require no experience, which means we lead you step by step, and you leave with a masterpiece you created and love.
